Ridgeview Fire: Evacuation Updates
Last updated: October 24, 2026, 6:20 PM PDT
Evacuation Order
An Evacuation Order is now in effect for zone SON-3A near the Ridgeview Fire, east of Santa Rosa. People in zone SON-3A must leave now.
Evacuation Warning
The Evacuation Warning remains in effect for zone SON-3B.
Zone SON-3A: Ridgeview Road from Highway 12 to Bennett Valley Road
Zone SON-3B: Matanzas Creek area
If you are in zone SON-3A, leave now.
